name: Grain spawn
definition: mushroom mycelium colonised on cereal grain, sold to inoculate bulk substrate or expand into more grain.

name: Sawdust spawn
definition: mushroom mycelium colonised on sawdust, sold to inoculate logs, beds and bulk substrate.

name: Plug spawn
definition: mushroom mycelium colonised on wooden dowels, hammered into drilled logs.

name: Mushroom liquid culture
definition: mushroom mycelium suspended in nutrient liquid, sold in a syringe or jar to inoculate grain or expand cultures.

name: Climbing rose
definition: rose with long canes trained on walls, arches and trellises.

name: Shrub rose
definition: large, vigorous bush rose grown as a garden shrub.

name: Hybrid tea rose
definition: bush rose bearing one large flower per stem, grown for cutting and display.
notes: Spring Hill category Hybrid Tea Roses

name: Floribunda rose
definition: bush rose bearing flowers in clusters.

name: Orange tree
definition: living sweet or blood orange tree grown for fruit.

name: Lemon and lime tree
definition: living lemon or lime tree grown for fruit.
notes: Brite Leaf category Lemon & Lime Trees

name: Mandarin tree
definition: living mandarin, tangerine or tangelo tree grown for fruit.
notes: Brite Leaf category Mandarin, Tangerine & Tangelo Trees
